decisions.title: Batch or events?
decisions.choice_reason: UC-02 needs updates visible in under 10 seconds.

options.title: Cron batch
options.reason: Too slow for UC-02: freshness is hours, not seconds.

options.title: Event queue
options.reason: Meets the 10 second target with services already on AWS.

options.title: Webhook push
options.reason: No partner API to receive webhooks.

decisions.title: Which queue technology?
decisions.choice_reason: SQS is the cheapest option and is already in the AWS account.

options.title: SQS
options.reason: Cheapest, no new vendor, enough for the expected volume.

options.title: Kafka
options.reason: More power than the current volume needs.
options.revisit_when: Sustained load above 1,000 events per second.
